LanguageData.Skill_DesperateArmyWin.label: Desperate Army's Victory
LanguageData.Skill_DesperateArmyWin.description:
When mood is below 50%, gain significant stat bonuses based on how low the mood is.

Strength/Endurance/Agility: +200 × t + 100
Will: +300 × t + 150
(t = (50% - mood%) / 50%)
LanguageData.Skill_LanceCharge.label: Lance Charge
LanguageData.Skill_LanceCharge.description: Requires a melee weapon (sharp). Dash toward a target point within 10 tiles, dealing 150% damage to enemies along the path and knocking them back.
LanguageData.Skill_Railgun.label: Railgun
LanguageData.Skill_Railgun.description: Requires a ranged weapon. Charges the weapon with electromagnetic energy: the next 5 shots pierce along the bullet path, dealing 200% damage and stunning enemies for 2 seconds. Walls block the shot and take piercing damage.
LanguageData.Skill_BerserkerChaos.description: Always active: the more badly wounded this person is, the higher their melee damage.
LanguageData.Skill_BerserkerChaos.label: Berserker Chaos
LanguageData.Skill_Ember.description: Triggers when knocked down: forces this person to stay alive for a short time and rapidly repair their injuries, then forces them into a coma.
LanguageData.Skill_Ember.label: Ember
LanguageData.Skill_FlameAffinity.description: Always active: greatly increases heat armor and maximum comfortable temperature, increases flammability, removes any fear of fire, and continuously heals injuries while burning.
LanguageData.Skill_FlameAffinity.label: Flame Affinity
LanguageData.Skill_IaiSpiritSlash.description: Requires a melee weapon (sharp). Enters an iai stance, absorbing all damage taken. After 3 seconds, draws the blade and flashes a short distance in the chosen direction, dealing 100% damage plus 50% of the absorbed damage to enemies near the path.
LanguageData.Skill_IaiSpiritSlash.label: Iai Spirit Slash
LanguageData.Skill_Provoke.description: Can be used while drafted: makes enemies within 20 tiles target this person for 3 hours.
LanguageData.Skill_Provoke.label: Provoke
LanguageData.Skill_RoundhouseKick.description: Choose a single enemy within the 8 tiles adjacent to this person, dealing 100% unarmed damage and knocking them back 5 tiles. If the knockback path is blocked, deals a further 200% damage. Stores 3 charges, each with a 3 hour cooldown.
LanguageData.Skill_RoundhouseKick.label: Roundhouse Kick
LanguageData.Skill_SwordRain.description: Requires a melee weapon (sharp). Deals two hits of 100% damage to enemies within 4 tiles. A kill or a downed enemy immediately resets the cooldown (up to two times).
LanguageData.Skill_SwordRain.label: Sword Rain
